correctness.rationale: PASS: On the recursive tree, direct single-step delta relations give ΔZ=(ζ/(1+t)-1_{parent leaf})B_parent and drift -Z/n, so (n-1)Z_n is a martingale. The second-moment recursion with E L_n=n/2 yields E Z_n²=n(3-t²)/(6(1+t)²), n>=3. An independent exact-rational exhaustive enumeration of all parent choices and edge signs for n=3..6 and seven t values including -3/4,0,1 reproduces mean zero and variance. L_n/n ->1/2 in L2 by independent parent choices; predictable quadratic variation of scaled martingale ->sigma_t², deterministic Lindeberg bound, giving Gaussian CLT. For t>1/2, X_n/mu_n L2 martingale converges; stable CLT conditional on fixed-time histories yields independence of asymptotic residual and W_t. Boundary t=-1 excluded, t=1 permitted; n=2 variance formula not asserted.
